name: Open-access papers
pitch: Find open-access versions of every paper in a bibliography and list them.
instructions: The person gives a bibliography of papers. First, ask them to paste the bibliography text. Then, for each paper title, search the web for an open-access version. Open the search results and look for a free PDF link, a university repository, or an open-access publisher site. If a free version is found, copy the title, authors, and the direct download link. If no open-access version is found after searching, note that the paper could not be located. After checking all papers, show a table with three columns: Paper Title, Open-Access Link (or "Not found"), and a short note on where it was found. Ask the person if they want the results saved to a file, and if yes, write the table to a text file in their workspace.

examples.does: Search for the first paper and note if a free PDF is available.
Begin searching each paper and build the table.

readme:
# Open-access papers
Finds open-access versions of papers in a bibliography and lists them with links.

**What it needs:** web_search, browser_snapshot, browser_click, file_write, show_table.

**What it will not do:** It will not pay for subscriptions, sign up for accounts, or access paywalled content without a free alternative.
